title: Slopes Ski Session Vertical Meters Leaderboard
dataSources: Slopes ski sessions (`slopes:session`), Ski Tracks runs (`skitracks:run`), OnTheSnow resort reports (`onthesnow:report`), snow safety checks (`snow:safety`), and Ikon Pass lift scans (`ikon:pass`).
app: Slopes ski sessions, Ski Tracks GPS runs, OnTheSnow resort reports, snow safety checklist logs, and Ikon Pass scan exports forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=slopes:session vertical_m=*
| stats sum(vertical_m) as total_value, avg(vertical_m) as avg_value by resort_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks resort values by total and average vertical meters across Slopes ski session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `vertical_m` values for each Slopes ski session event and review total and average vertical meters by resort.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total vertical meters.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which resort shows the biggest vertical meters numbers in your Slopes ski session data.
